name: Inspections Feed
description: Every inspection across all asset types, most recent first. One tab per asset; each paginates independently.

items.label: WWTP — inspections
items.info:
Every registered site in this family, most recently inspected first.
Ordered server-side by the inspection-date answer (order_by=last_inspected). Sites never inspected have no date and sort last, so the tail of the feed is the never-visited backlog.
No criteria are sent, so the backend slices the query directly rather than matching every parent id per request. One page is fetched at a time.
items.description: Most recent inspection first; never-inspected sites appear last. One page is fetched at a time.
